blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Upper Eagle Ridge is the upper, northern part of the Eagle Ridge house area on the slope below Westwood Plateau, and the City publishes no official boundary for the multiple listing service sub-area name.
Its centre streets are Falcon Drive, Charter Hill Drive and the upper part of Lansdowne Drive, roughly Guildford Way south, David Avenue north and Johnson Street west.
Addressed anchors are Eagle Ridge Elementary at 1215 Falcon Drive, Eagle Ridge Park, and Coquitlam Crunch Trail access points at Eagle Ridge Park, on Lansdowne Drive and at David Avenue.
The City Centre Area Plan Schedule A map includes the Falcon Drive and Lansdowne Drive area, with David Avenue at the north edge of the mapped area.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses here are the one-family stock on the Falcon Drive, Charter Hill Drive and upper Lansdowne Drive slope; the City Centre Area Plan Schedule A legend shows "One Family Residential" and "Compact One Family Residential" designations in this part of the plan area, with apartment and townhousing designations closer to City Centre.

The slope is the stock's defining physical fact in official sources: the City's Crunch Trail page records 242 metres of elevation gain from the Lansdowne Drive and Eagle Ridge Park side to the top of Westwood Plateau, the plateau this pocket climbs toward.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Wildfire rule: Coquitlam has an Interface Wildfire Risk Management Development Permit Area, with FireSmart landscaping and exterior design guidelines in Part 4 of the former Citywide Official Community Plan, and the City's Community Wildfire Resiliency Plan 2021 states about 23% of the Coquitlam wildland urban interface has a moderate wildfire behaviour threat or higher.

Plan frame, check current: no plan is named for Eagle Ridge; the whole city is under the Interim Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 5511, 2026, adopted April 27, 2026, and the Northwest Coquitlam Area Plan, carried in as a Schedule J schedule, covers the Westwood Plateau lands immediately above this pocket.

blocks.text: Upper Eagle Ridge Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Guildford Way at Falcon Drive and Guildford Way at Lansdowne Drive are both named protected left-turn locations in the City's 2026 capital list, and the Falcon Drive and Guildford Way intersection also has a pressure-reducing valve replacement listed for spring.

Portables moved out of the neighbouring Scott Creek Middle in 2025 are a capacity signal to ask about: School District No. 43 board minutes state five portables were relocated from Scott Creek Middle, four to Minnekhada Middle for the 2025/26 school year.

items.t: The rail connection for these routes is Coquitlam Central Station, south of the pocket, with the Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and West Coast Express.

items.t: Check the Community Wildfire Resiliency Plan 2021 threat mapping: about 23% of Coquitlam's wildland urban interface rates moderate wildfire behaviour threat or higher, and the plan's FireSmart actions are aimed at homes backing onto natural green space in interface neighbourhoods.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses listed in Upper Eagle Ridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Upper Eagle Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Upper Eagle Ridge had a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Upper Eagle Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 1 houses sold in Upper Eagle Ridge over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which schools serve Upper Eagle Ridge — is it Dr. Charles Best and Minnekhada?
faq.a: The schools physically in the area, all School District No. 43, are Eagle Ridge Elementary at 1215 Falcon Drive, kindergarten to Grade 5, Scott Creek Middle at 1240 Lansdowne Drive, Grades 6 to 8, and Gleneagle Secondary at 1195 Lansdowne Drive, Grades 9 to 12. École Dr. Charles Best Secondary is listed at 2525 Como Lake Avenue in central Coquitlam and Minnekhada Middle in Port Coquitlam; catchment is by home address, so run the specific address in the district School Locator.

faq.q: How steep is the slope above these houses?
faq.a: The City measures the climb beside the pocket, not each street. A specific Charter Hill Drive lot's grade still needs its own survey.

faq.q: Does wildfire planning affect a Falcon Drive house?
faq.a: It can, at the permit stage. Coquitlam regulates high-risk interface areas through an Interface Wildfire Risk Management Development Permit Area, and its Community Wildfire Resiliency Plan 2021 records that FireSmart landscaping and exterior finish guidelines sit in Part 4 of the former Citywide plan. The City also describes a wildfire buffer in northwest Coquitlam and FireSmart property assessments on interface properties. Whether a specific lot is inside the permit boundary is a City map check, not a neighbourhood label.

faq.q: Is Upper Eagle Ridge in a floodplain?
faq.a: The local water check is different: Scott Creek runs through the wider Eagle Ridge area, the City classifies its creeks for environmental value and monitors creek levels, and lots within 30 metres of a watercourse bank in this plan area fall in the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area.

faq.q: What did houses in Upper Eagle Ridge sell for?
faq.a: 6 houses sold in Upper Eagle Ridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,501,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: The median was 41 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.6% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
